a.lede: NASA anticipates that Voyager 1 will be the first human-made object to reach space beyond one light-day away from Earth on Wednesday.
a.title: Voyager 1 spacecraft crosses milestones distance of one-light day from Earth 49 years after launch

b.lede: As the world is hit by IT snafu after IT snafu, Voyager sails on, almost half a century after launch
b.title: Space robot legend Voyager 1 is now more than 1 light-day away
